$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: A matching resume preserves identities and continues increasing revisions
summary: On reconnect the phone offers resumeSessionId equal to the retained session. The desktop accepts with the same sessionId and resumed: true within the 60-second detached-session TTL. Task and Instruction identities and monotonic state revisions continue. The first resumed state marks retained guidance may_be_outdated, uses phase recovering, and requires a fresh reconnected observation before evidence may become current.

steps.note: Exact closed v1 hello on the new connection. Wire mode resets to v1 until a new acceptance. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1, §5)
resumeSessionId names the retained detached session. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5)
Same sessionId, resumed: true. The phone preserves accepted intention, Task, and Instruction identities. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5)

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

activity.text: Reconnected—checking the view before coaching resumes.

steps.note: First resumed state: revision continues (11 > prior 10), retained Instruction is may_be_outdated, phase recovering, recovering Activity. A fresh reconnected observation must become Settled before evidence may become current. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5, §6.1)

outcome: Successful resume preserves session, task, and Instruction identities and continues strictly increasing revisions. The phone MUST NOT reset revisions within a resumed session.
